value.body: A dental lecturer teaches BDS students in a dental college and supervises them in the college's clinics, while also treating patients. Private and government dental colleges hire lecturers. A typical day is lectures or practical classes, clinical supervision and patient work.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: BDS for tutor/lecturer posts; MDS for senior lecturer and above

items.label: Teaching norms
items.value: Set by the Dental Council of India

value.title: How you get in
value.body: BDS graduates can join a dental college as a tutor or lecturer in some departments after registration. Promotion to senior lecturer, reader and professor generally requires an MDS (through NEET-MDS) and teaching experience as set out in Dental Council of India norms.

value.title: At a glance
items: Without an MDS, growth in teaching posts is limited.
Typical path: tutor/lecturer, senior lecturer, reader, professor.
Many combine college work with a private clinic, where college rules allow.
